jobs.name: fx-nota-sonica
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Separate transparent VFX sprite sheet for Majis, sonic punk guitarist in Salvadores Nacionais 2D comic fighting game. EXACTLY FOUR consecutive animation frames, 2x2 equal square cells, isolated effects only, no character, hands, guitar, scene, ground plane or text. Crisp black ink edges, celshaded electric CYAN, WHITE and subtle VIOLET accents, restrained comic halftone, graphic readable high contrast shapes. Match inked fighting game art. Transparent alpha, no rectangular backdrops, no colored fog outside intended effect. Each entire effect fully fits its cell with20% blank transparent margin, never crosses cells. Same origin and scale across4frames. Four clearly distinct stages, one animated effect family. Camera sideview. Frame1 compact charged note, frame2 stretched note/crescent energy, frame3 pulsing wider echo, frame4 compact trailing wave ready loop. Centered origin.
